item.title: JD Vance Defers on Iran Strike Question, Says President Will Make Announcements
item.description: Reporter: Can you explain to the American people why the US would need to strike Iran to stop them from getting a nuclear weapon if the US ‘obliterated’ their enrichment program last summer? JD Vance: I’m not going to make any news on Iran today, I’ll let the president make those announcements.
